description: Exact sample size per variant for an A/B test on a conversion rate (two independent proportions): baseline rate, minimum detectable effect (relative or absolute), alpha, power, one or two-sided, several variants with optional Bonferroni, and unequal allocation. Uses the pooled/unpooled normal formula (same as R power.prop.test) and also reports the figure Evan Miller's calculator gives, so the two can be reconciled.

allocation_ratio.description: Users in each variant per user in control. 1 = even split.

baseline_rate.description: Control conversion rate as a proportion, for example 0.042 for 4.2%.

bonferroni.description: Split alpha across the variant-vs-control comparisons (Bonferroni).

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect. Relative by default (0.10 = a 10% lift); set mde_type "absolute" for percentage points as a proportion (0.01 = 1 point).

variants.description: Number of arms including control. 2 = A/B, 3 = A/B/C.

name: calculate_sample_size
title: A/B test sample size calculator
